chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Mansur ibn al-Abbas, from Abdul Aziz ibn Hassan al-Baghdadi, from Salih ibn Uqba, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Ju'fi, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) mentioned the onion, so he said: 'It aromatises the breath, and does away with the phlegm, and increases in the copulation'.
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of onions according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the therapeutic properties of onions, specifically their ability to purify breath, expel phlegm, and increase sexual vigor. This narration reflects the broader Shia tradition of *Tibb al-Nabi* (Prophetic Medicine), where natural foods are viewed as divine remedies for both physical ailments and spiritual well-being, emphasizing the holistic connection between diet and bodily function.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from sahl Bin Ziyad, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Abdul Aziz bin Hassan Al Baghdady, from Salih Bin Uqba, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Al Ju’fy who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> mentioned the onions, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It aromatises the breath, and does away with the phlegm, and increases in the copulation’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Mansur ibn al-‘Abbas from ‘Abd ‘Abd al-’Aziz ibn Hassan from Salih ibn ‘Uqbah from ‘Abd Allah ibn Muhammad al-Al-Ju‘fiy who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once mentioned onion and said, ‘It is well flavored and it dissolves phlegm and increases one’s ability to go to bed with his wife.’”
